subject: Request: provisional Net terms extension & short-term credit buffer
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@thermapixel.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@thermapixel.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:18:00 +0200
Subject: Request to extend Net terms and provisional credit facility

Hi Avery,

Following our pilot spike, we’re preparing a larger deployment and need to align billing terms ahead of the July launch. Our procurement team is asking whether Redwood can accommodate a temporary Net60 for the first two monthly invoices while we complete internal approvals.

Specific asks:
- Temporary Net60 for invoices dated Jun–Aug (move to Net30 thereafter).
- Short-term increase to credit ceiling to €250,000 for June and July only.
- Invoices should include VAT charged to our Italian entity (ThermaPixel S.r.l.). We’ll provide VAT registration details once you confirm routing.

I attached the PO for the augmentation and a screenshot of our payment calendar. Can you confirm feasibility and what evidence Redwood needs for VAT invoicing? Also flag any requirement for an upfront deposit if you need extra credit cover.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement | ThermaPixel
elena.rossi@thermapixel.com

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in. ThermaPixel (EU) is requesting temporary Net60 + short-term credit bump to €250k. They intend to revert to Net30 after Aug.

Key points to consider:
- VAT: they want VAT charged to their Italian entity. Do we need their VAT number on file and an EU invoice flow?
- Credit: can we provisionally increase credit limit for two billing cycles contingent on a 25% upfront retainer?
- Risk: pilot usage shows bursty spikes — I flagged that for potential consumption smoothing.

I’ve attached a working credit worksheet (Redwood_Credit_Worksheet_AJ_v2.xlsx) with their historical pilot spend pulled from the console. If we require a deposit, I propose 25% of the first invoice amount as a conditional requirement to approve the Net60 window. Thoughts?

—Avery

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request to extend Net terms and provisional credit facility

Avery — thanks for the context and the worksheet. A few recommendations from finance/AR side: 

1) Proposed commercial compromise:
   - Approve Net45 for Jun–Aug (midpoint between Net30 and Net60) as a temporary concession.
   - Require 25% upfront retainer on the first Jun invoice (applies to both pilot augmentation and new committed spend). Retainer will be applied against the July invoice.
   - Set provisional credit ceiling at €200,000 (instead of €250k) for June and July, with a formal credit review to reset by 01 Sep.

2) VAT handling:
   - We can invoice VAT to ThermaPixel S.r.l. but we need: 1) valid EU VAT number, 2) billing contact & legal entity to appear on the invoice, 3) confirmation whether reverse-charge applies. Please capture VAT ID now (accounts-payable@thermapixel.com).

3) Contractual/ops asks:
   - Add a short clause to the SOW: "temporary payment terms and provisional credit limit" and sign via DocuSign prior to provisioning.
   - If their usage exceeds credit ceiling before the deposit clears, chargecard fallback to avoid service interruption (we prefer to avoid throttling).

If they insist on Net60 we should ask for a larger retainer (40%) or push to milestone invoicing. Net45 + 25% retainer seems like a low friction path.

I’ll draft the short amendment to the SOW once Avery confirms and can provide the exact invoice amounts.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Credit_Eval_MC_20260604.pdf (pdf, 36KB)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@thermapixel.com>

Thanks, Marissa and Avery — that framework works for us. We accept: Net45 for Jun–Aug with a 25% upfront retainer on the first June invoice and the provisional €200,000 credit ceiling.

Action items from our side:
- We will send VAT ID + legal-entity confirmation to accounts-payable@redwood.com by end of day Monday.
- Accounts-payable will route the 25% retainer payment as soon as we receive the amended SOW and invoice.
- Please send the DocuSign link for the SOW amendment and the updated invoice routing (billing address + VAT fields) so we can expedite.

I’ve copied Marco (finance) to coordinate the payment and the PO reference. Once we have the DocuSign link we’ll route internally.

Elena Rossi
